dialogues.speaker: Tikhon
dialogues.text: If you have no urgent business here, please pass through quickly and do not linger.

dialogues.speaker: Tikhon
dialogues.text: But if you encounter any problems such as damaged roads, falling rocks blocking the way, or mud after the rain...

dialogues.speaker: Tikhon
dialogues.text: Please do come and tell me. I'll notify the relevant personnel to make repairs, then bring my trainees along to observe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I shan't disturb you any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that part of your job, too?

dialogues.speaker: Tikhon
dialogues.text: No. It's just that I started out as a sapper, so I pay rather close attention to such things.

dialogues.speaker: Tikhon
dialogues.text: Who knows what might go wrong if fighting breaks out? Road conditions have to be monitored at all times.
